module.purpose: Provides a memoized factory that builds the core row model for a table by recursively transforming data into Row objects with hierarchy.
module.summary: This module exports a single factory function that returns a memoized getter for the core row model of a table. The returned function computes a row model containing rows, flatRows, and rowsById by recursively walking the provided data and any subrows defined via table options. It leverages memoization keyed on the table's data and supports auto-reset hooks for paging.
module.businessContext: Part of a headless table-core library. Responsible for deriving the fundamental row structure; failure breaks all table rendering.
functions: getCoreRowModel (~L5-82): Factory returning memoized core row model builder
accessRows (~L24-72): Recursively builds row objects with subrows

detail.name: getCoreRowModel
detail.signature: export function getCoreRowModel<TData extends RowData>(): (table: Table<TData>) => () => RowModel<TData>
preconditions: table is a Table instance with options.data array
table._getRowId is a function returning a string ID for a row
table.options.getSubRows is optional and if present returns TData[] | undefined
postconditions: Returns a function accepting a table and returning a zero-arg function that returns a RowModel
Returned RowModel contains rows, flatRows, rowsById populated from data
invariants: Every row appears exactly once in flatRows
rowsById maps row.id to the row object
Subrows are attached to parent row.subRows only when originalSubRows length > 0
Row IDs are unique within a single RowModel
edgeCases: Empty data array yields RowModel with empty rows, flatRows, rowsById
options.getSubRows undefined yields rows with subRows undefined
getSubRows returns empty array yields no subRows (length check fails)
Top-level rows have parentRow undefined and depth 0
stateMutations: Populates the rowModel object's rows, flatRows, rowsById arrays/records
Invokes table._autoResetPageIndex() when memo recomputes (via getMemoOptions callback)
detail.summary: Returns a memoized builder that, given a Table, produces a RowModel from table.options.data, recursively resolving subrows and assigning IDs, while auto-resetting page index on cache invalidation.

preconditions: closure variables table and rowModel are initialized and accessible

detail.summary: Recursively constructs Row objects from original data rows, populating the closure rowModel with flat and indexed rows, and attaches nested subrows via the table's getSubRows option.
